explanation: The stone's decree honours Ptolemy V, of the same Greek-speaking dynasty as Cleopatra. It repeats one text in hieroglyphs, demotic script and Greek, which let scholars crack hieroglyphs.

claims.text: The decree carved on the Rosetta Stone was issued in 196 BC.
Cleopatra VII became queen of Egypt in 51 BC.
The Rosetta Stone's decree honours Ptolemy V, of the Ptolemaic dynasty to which Cleopatra VII belonged.
The Rosetta Stone carries the same decree in hieroglyphs, demotic script and ancient Greek.
The Rosetta Stone was the key to deciphering Egyptian hieroglyphs.
